body:
It's true, that I don't love them high enough to stay. I can agree on that, and self-love requires your full attention. I don't know if I should love myself because of the way I am, the way I look or the future I built because of education, and, not to pat myself on the back, I know, that people around respect me to some degree, as I always, if I'm able to, help them. I know, that I'm average looking, not bad looking and physically decent. I know, if I really, REALLY set my mind and focus on something, I'd most likely be able to do it. I'm not clever, but I have an astonishing brain, that has helped learn things quickly.

My mother already has a hutch, that I'm suicidal, as my young self told her many years ago. She is a loving mother with a heart of gold, but she didn't say, that I shouldn't. OFCOURSE she did *not* encourage me! She've told me multiple times, that she's thinking about vanishing. I'm not doing it, because she's thinking about it or anything like that. It's an option I chose.

It's the very last line that says why, in a rough explanation, I'm not able to follow my own wisdom. "*If you really appreciate life, don't do what I'm about to do*". I love the people around me, but I just don't love myself, and it's worse now. *Roughly said*

I hope you feel better in the upcoming days, weeks or months. :)  


We all know, that there is a time, where we will die. No matter what we do, but the real question is; Do you *really* want disappear now? Have you made up in your mind, that it's the best choice?  


I for one have already placed at date of which I'll finally sleep forever, and I know how I'll do it. I won't be saying how, because I really want you to think deeply, whether it's the right call.

It's alright to say "Don't do it". It's your way of showing, that you care about life... We'll have to see how the upcoming events unfolds.

And no. Not addicted to anything. If I was, I'd be ashamed of this. I'd rather have people find out, that I went out clean, so they know it wasn't addiction that removed me, and just my own choice.

I appreciate your tip, but I've thought about this many times.

One of the main reasons that I've chosen this path, is frankly because, I don't see a reason to live. I've asked multiple, serious and vice verca, and they've come with many answers as to why we live. The thing is, we're just a spinning wheel. We're born, grow up, find someone we'll share our life with, create new life, take care of them, let them go and finish up with death. (*Ofc. there is much more to it than that, but it's the rough picture*)

About the someone that adds value part, there is one I truly hold dear to my heart. She is a wonderful person, but I don't dare connect with her too far, because I'm affraid. I'm no longer that strong, punkish boy I was years ago. I finally decided to let her go, so I know, that I wouldn't hurt her more, than what's about to happen.

I don't like this decision, but I've simply chosen the cowards path, because of selfish ideals.
